principles.label: Context before compute
principles.signal: Use deeper reasoning and targeted file reads before running heavy local commands.
principles.guardrail: Avoid broad scans of generated caches, dependency folders, and build output.

principles.label: Static-first validation
principles.signal: Prefer syntax checks, JSON contracts, locale checks, and focused foundation gates.
principles.guardrail: Run production packaging only when it proves release readiness.

principles.label: Cinematic with fallbacks
principles.signal: Increase atmosphere through CSS, canvas, and content rhythm before heavier 3D dependencies.
principles.guardrail: Every immersive effect keeps reduced-motion and mobile-safe behavior.

principles.label: Small reversible diffs
principles.signal: Ship one coherent surface at a time so rollback stays simple.
principles.guardrail: Keep unrelated repo noise out of the current development slice.
